svg.title: The Locky case: one opened attachment, four steps during, four after
svg.desc: On a Monday morning one user with permissions opened a malicious attachment and Locky began encrypting files. During the attack the team examined logs, switched the affected server's file system to read-only to stop further encryption, found the infected system and cut it off the network, and prepared to recover. Afterward they documented, restored from backups, educated users, and communicated.
svg.text: The Locky case: one opened attachment, four steps during, four after

g.text: cut the host off the network
The responders say they were partly lucky and skipped steps they later formalized:
breaches start with people, process beats panic, and recovery depends on backups made long before.
